description: Bilateral Air Services Consultations between Sri Lanka and Poland
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-11-19
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Piyankara Jayaratne, Minister of Civil Aviation, to sign the above Air Services Agreement by an accredited representative of Sri Lanka and thereafter to take appropriate measures for its entry into force, was approved the Cabinet.
